tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: GET /v1/contratacoes/proposta ('Consultar Contratações com Recebimento de Propostas Aberto'): procurements whose proposal period is open now. dataFinal (required, AAAAMMDD) is fixed to 20991231 so every open procurement is included; pagina = page, tamanhoPagina = limit and must be 10–50 (a smaller limit is refused with 400 'must be greater than or equal to 10'). The API has no keyword filter, so `query` and min_budget are not sent; `category` is the numeric codigoModalidadeContratacao (e.g. 6 = Pregão Eletrônico, 8 = Dispensa). budget_max = valorTotalEstimado (BRL), url = linkSistemaOrigem (the buyer's system where proposals are submitted), deadline = dataEncerramentoProposta; uf/município are in raw.unidadeOrgao. A page past the end answers 204 (empty list).
